condition_monitoring_query_language.query: fetch consumer_quota|{metric serviceruntime.googleapis.com/quota/allocation/usage|filter metric.quota_metric=='compute.googleapis.com/routers'|map add [metric.limit_name: 'ROUTERS-per-project']|align next_older(1d)|group_by [resource.project_id,resource.service,metric.quota_metric,metric.limit_name],.max;metric serviceruntime.googleapis.com/quota/limit|filter metric.quota_metric=='compute.googleapis.com/routers'&&metric.limit_name=='ROUTERS-per-project'|align next_older(1d)|group_by [resource.project_id,resource.service,metric.quota_metric,metric.limit_name],.min}|ratio|every 30s|condition gt(val(), 0.8 '1')

documentation.content: To resolve this issue, click [here](https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?service=${resource.label.service}&metric=${metric.label.quota_metric}&limit=${metric.label.limit_name}&project=netapp-us-c1-sde&fromNotifications=1) to review quota usage and optionally request a quota increase.
